title: Boston Harbor Private Sunset & Foliage Cruise, on Yacht Trinacria
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Witness the breathtaking Boston Harbor skyline and many landmarks from the unique perspective of the harbor. We are one of the only Private Sunset Cruises in Boston. The Boat will only have you, your guests and our crew. We will provide complimentary Water and Soft Drinks. You are welcome bring you favorite food and Beverages on-board to enjoy during your cruise. As a reminder Gratuities are not included in your fare. This Tour runs over a 10 to 12 mile loop of the harbor which takes 2 Hours and 30 Minutes. You will have plenty of time to take photos and make lasting memories. we travel at a slow rate of speed and the cruise is very enjoyable. 

AS THE DAYS GET SHORTER Start and end times will be modified in order to coincide with sunset times.
TRIP MAY BECOME LESS THAN 2.5 HOURS
Trip ends 30 minutes after sunset in Aug/Sept.
